# SafePDFHub

> Browser-based PDF tools and DOCX conversion.

This is a public navigation index. Each linked tool page is authoritative for its current workflow, supported formats, device limits, and limitations. User documents and processing results are not public content.

## PDF tools
- [Compress PDF](https://safepdfhub.com/tools/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF size locally with lossless or image compression, or try a target size in MB. Up to 500 MB on supported desktops; device limits apply.
- [Merge PDF](https://safepdfhub.com/tools/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF files into one. Fast, secure, and works in your browser.
- [Split PDF](https://safepdfhub.com/tools/split-pdf): Extract pages or split a PDF into separate files locally in your browser. No document upload required.
- [Protect PDF](https://safepdfhub.com/tools/protect-pdf): Password-protect a PDF locally in your browser with optional permissions.
- [Unlock PDF](https://safepdfhub.com/tools/unlock-pdf): Remove PDF password protection locally when you know the document password.
- [Sign PDF](https://safepdfhub.com/tools/sign-pdf): Add a signature, initials, text, dates, and checkboxes to a PDF locally in your browser.
- [Watermark PDF](https://safepdfhub.com/tools/watermark-pdf): Add text or image watermarks to PDF pages locally in your browser with adjustable opacity, rotation, position, and page range.
- [PDF to Word](https://safepdfhub.com/tools/pdf-to-word): Convert PDFs to Word DOCX locally. Extract editable text or preserve pages as images. Recognize scanned English, Hindi or Marathi text with local OCR. Up to 200 MB with no fixed page limit.
- [Word to PDF](https://safepdfhub.com/tools/word-to-pdf): Convert Word DOCX files to downloadable PDFs locally in your browser. Files up to 200 MB; no document uploads or conversion server.
